description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different configurations in a study on misinformation detection. The horizontal axis represents various configurations, while the vertical axis shows the accuracy percentage. The configurations include "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition." The accuracy percentages range from approximately 80.1% to 90.57%. The "Ours" configuration has the highest accuracy at 89.84%, followed by "w/o emotion" at 88.80%, and "w/o cognition" at 87.74%. The lowest accuracy is observed in the "w/o text" configuration at 80.1%. The chart uses different colors for each configuration, with "Ours" in red, "w/o comments" in orange, "w/o text" in yellow, "w/o select" in light blue, "w/o emotion" in dark blue, and "w/o cognition" in teal. The values are displayed above each bar, and the chart is organized in a clear, easy-to-read manner without any additional emphasis on specific bars.
